# PriorityIcon

<!-- description:start -->
Displays the icon for a Tracker issue priority level (blocker, critical, normal, minor, etc.). Each priority maps to a distinct icon and color. Unknown priority keys fall back to the normal icon.
<!-- description:end -->

## Usage

```tsx
import {PriorityIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<PriorityIcon priority="critical" />
```

## Component props

<!-- props:start -->
```ts
{
    /**
     * Priority key. Known values are listed below; any other string is
     * accepted and falls back to the normal icon.
     */
    priority?:
        | 'blocker'
        | 'critical'
        | 'important'
        | 'minor'
        | 'minimal'
        | 'normal'
        | 'trivial'
        | string;

    /**
     * Size of the icon in pixels.
     * @default 16
     */
    size?: number;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the icon element.
     */
    className?: string;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the outer container element.
     */
    containerClassName?: string;

    /**
     * Human-readable display name for the priority (e.g. `"Critical"`, `"Normal"`).
     * When provided, an accessible label `"Priority: <title>"` is rendered for
     * screen readers. When omitted, the icon is treated as decorative (`aria-hidden`).
     */
    title?: string;

    /**
     * When true, renders a circular colored background behind the icon.
     */
    showBackground?: boolean;

    /**
     * Size of the background circle in pixels. Only used when `showBackground` is true.
     */
    backgroundSize?: number;

    /**
     * When true, applies meta-entity color variants (e.g. `critical` uses
     * the blocker icon and danger color instead of warning).
     */
    metaEntity?: boolean;
}
```
<!-- props:end -->

---

## Examples

### Single icon

```tsx
import {PriorityIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<PriorityIcon priority="blocker" />
<PriorityIcon priority="critical" />
<PriorityIcon priority="normal" />
```

### Custom size

```tsx
<PriorityIcon priority="critical" size={24} />
<PriorityIcon priority="critical" size={32} />
```

### With background

```tsx
<PriorityIcon priority="blocker" showBackground backgroundSize={32} />
```

### Alongside issue summary

```tsx
import {PriorityIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

export const IssueRow = ({issue}: {issue: {priority: string; summary: string}}) => (
    <div style={{display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8}}>
        <PriorityIcon priority={issue.priority} size={16} />
        <span>{issue.summary}</span>
    </div>
);
```

### All known priorities

```tsx
import {PriorityIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

const PRIORITIES = [
    'blocker', 'critical', 'important', 'normal', 'minor', 'minimal', 'trivial',
] as const;

export const PriorityGallery = () => (
    <div style={{display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 16}}>
        {PRIORITIES.map((p) => (
            <div key={p} style={{display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4}}>
                <PriorityIcon priority={p} size={24} />
                <span style={{fontSize: 11}}>{p}</span>
            </div>
        ))}
    </div>
);
```

### From Tracker API

Requires the `"tracker:issues:read"` permission in your plugin's `manifest.json`:

```json
{
    "permissions": {
        "data": ["tracker:issues:read"]
    }
}
```

```tsx
import {PriorityIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

const priority = await trackerApi.v3.get['/issues/{id}/{field}']({
    pathParams: {
        id: 'ISSUEKEY-1',
        field: 'priority',
    },
});

<PriorityIcon
    priority={priority.data.key}
    title={priority.data.display}
/>
```

---

## Notes

- The `priority` value is matched case-sensitively against the known keys. Values returned by the Tracker API (e.g. `"blocker"`, `"critical"`) match directly without transformation.
- Passing an unknown string does not throw — the component renders the normal (default) icon.
- When `title` is omitted the icon is treated as decorative and gets `aria-hidden="true"`. Pass `title` (e.g. `priority.display` from the API) to make the icon accessible.
- The `metaEntity` prop changes the icon and color for `critical` priority to match the blocker appearance, used in meta-entity contexts like goals and projects.
